meaning.en: People coming and going from all directions.
meaning.zh: 有的从南来，有的往北去。泛指来来往往。

examples.zh: 车站里挤满了南来北往的旅客。
examples.en: The station was packed with travellers coming and going.

examples.zh: 这条古道上曾有南来北往的商队。
examples.en: Caravans once came and went along this ancient road.

meaning.en: To wander from place to place in hardship.
meaning.zh: 生活艰难，四处流浪。

equivalents: a life of hardship and exile

examples.zh: 战争年代，他们一家颠沛流离。
examples.en: During the war his family drifted from place to place in hardship.

examples.zh: 她回忆起童年颠沛流离的生活。
examples.en: She recalled her childhood of wandering and hardship.

meaning.en: To flee in such panic that one takes any road.
meaning.zh: 慌忙中顾不上选择道路。形容惊慌失措，乱跑乱撞。

examples.zh: 小偷被发现后慌不择路，一头撞上了电线杆。
examples.en: Spotted, the thief fled in blind panic and ran straight into a lamp post.

examples.zh: 投资者慌不择路地抛售股票。
examples.en: Investors dumped their shares in a blind panic.

meaning.en: To issue orders and give commands.
meaning.zh: 发布命令，指挥别人。

examples.zh: 他刚升职就开始对大家发号施令。
examples.en: As soon as he was promoted he started bossing everyone around.

examples.zh: 在家里，奶奶才是发号施令的人。
examples.en: At home, it's Grandma who calls the shots.

story.en: King Mu urges his officials to make sure that whenever he 'issues orders and commands', none is wrong.
story.zh: 《尚书·冏命》：“发号施令，罔有不臧。”

date.zh: 东晋 · 约4世纪初（伪古文《尚书》篇章）
date.en: Eastern Jin, early 4th c. (spurious “Old Text” chapter of the Book of Documents)

usage.en: Predicate; often slightly critical of bossiness.

meaning.en: To cater to someone's likes in order to please them.
meaning.zh: 迎合别人的爱好。

equivalents: tell people what they want to hear

examples.zh: 他知道老板爱下棋，便投其所好。
examples.en: Knowing the boss loved chess, he played to his interests.

examples.zh: 商家投其所好，推出了各种怀旧产品。
examples.en: Retailers catered to customers' tastes with all kinds of nostalgic products.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常含讨好之意。

natural: up to the same old tricks

meaning.en: To play the same old trick again.
meaning.zh: 老花招又一次使用。

examples.zh: 骗子故伎重演，又盯上了独居老人。
examples.en: The conmen are up to their old tricks again, targeting elderly people living alone.

examples.zh: 对方故伎重演，但这次没有得逞。
examples.en: The opponents tried the same old trick, but this time it didn't work.

meaning.en: To read mechanically from a text without any flexibility.
meaning.zh: 照着本子念条文。比喻死板地按照现成的文字讲，不能灵活发挥。

examples.zh: 这位老师上课只会照本宣科，学生们都昏昏欲睡。
examples.en: This teacher just reads from the textbook and the students nod off.

examples.zh: 发言不要照本宣科，要讲出自己的想法。
examples.en: Don't just read from your notes when you speak — say what you think.

meaning.en: Everyone feels insecure and fears for themselves.
meaning.zh: 每个人都感到自己不安全。

examples.zh: 公司裁员的消息传开后，员工人人自危。
examples.en: Once news of layoffs spread, every employee feared for their job.

examples.zh: 连续几起盗窃案让小区居民人人自危。
examples.en: A string of burglaries left every resident feeling vulnerable.

meaning.en: To discuss national affairs together.
meaning.zh: 共同商讨国家大事。

examples.zh: 来自全国各地的代表齐聚北京，共商国是。
examples.en: Delegates from across the country gathered in Beijing to discuss affairs of state.

examples.zh: 每年三月，委员们共商国是，建言献策。
examples.en: Every March, committee members deliberate on national policy and put forward proposals.

usage.en: News register, especially about the annual 两会. Note 国是, not 国事.
usage.zh: 新闻用语，多用于两会报道。注意写作“国是”。

meaning.en: Alone, without help from anyone.
meaning.zh: 一支枪，一匹马。比喻单独行动，没有别人帮助。

examples.zh: 他单枪匹马创办了这家公司。
examples.en: He founded the company single-handed.

examples.zh: 这件事光靠你单枪匹马是办不成的。
examples.en: You can't pull this off on your own.

story.en: The Tang poet Wang Zun pictured Xiang Yu, his army scattered, breaking through the siege 'with a single spear and one horse'.
story.zh: 汪遵《乌江》：“兵散弓残挫虎威，单枪匹马突重围。”

meaning.en: The spirit of a dead person, thought of as being in heaven.
meaning.zh: 对死者的敬称，指死者的灵魂。

examples.zh: 愿父亲的在天之灵得到安息。
examples.en: May my father's spirit rest in peace.

examples.zh: 我们一定会完成他的遗愿，以告慰他的在天之灵。
examples.en: We will fulfil his last wishes to bring comfort to his spirit.

usage.en: Respectful; usually 告慰/安息 + 在天之灵.
usage.zh: 敬辞，常说“告慰……的在天之灵”。

meaning.en: To shout or cry until one is hoarse and exhausted.
meaning.zh: 嗓子喊哑了，力气用尽了。形容拼命地呼喊。

equivalents: at the top of one's voice

examples.zh: 球迷们声嘶力竭地为主队加油。
examples.en: The fans shouted themselves hoarse cheering on the home side.

examples.zh: 孩子哭得声嘶力竭。
examples.en: The child cried until he was hoarse.

usage.en: Adverbial or complement (哭得声嘶力竭).

meaning.en: An unnecessary action.
meaning.zh: 多做了这一个动作，指做了不必要的事。

examples.zh: 网上已经能办，还要跑一趟，真是多此一举。
examples.en: It can be done online, so going in person is completely unnecessary.

examples.zh: 你这么解释反而多此一举。
examples.en: Explaining it like that is just superfluous.

usage.en: Predicate; often 真是/未免多此一举.

meaning.en: Simple, honest and unassuming.
meaning.zh: 形容人老实本分、不善交际。

examples.zh: 他是个老实巴交的农民。
examples.en: He's a simple, honest farmer.

examples.zh: 别看他老实巴交的，干活可一点不含糊。
examples.en: He may look meek and simple, but he's very capable at work.

meaning.en: Tired out from a long journey.
meaning.zh: 坐船乘车，旅途劳累。

examples.zh: 各位舟车劳顿，先回酒店休息一下吧。
examples.en: You must be tired from the journey — go back to the hotel and rest first.

examples.zh: 经过一天的舟车劳顿，大家都累坏了。
examples.en: After a whole day of travelling, everyone was exhausted.

usage.en: Predicate or object; polite when greeting guests.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，常用于对客人的问候。

meaning.en: Strange and unusual.
meaning.zh: 形容很少见，很奇特。

examples.zh: 这孩子脑子里总有稀奇古怪的想法。
examples.en: This child always has weird and wonderful ideas.

examples.zh: 市场上摆满了稀奇古怪的小玩意儿。
examples.en: The market is full of bizarre little gadgets.

meaning.en: Too offensive or ugly to look at.
meaning.zh: 形容事物丑恶或格调低下，使人看不下去。

examples.zh: 网上有些内容不堪入目。
examples.en: Some content online is downright obscene.

examples.zh: 那幅涂鸦简直不堪入目。
examples.en: That graffiti is a real eyesore.

meaning.en: To frown with worry.
meaning.zh: 由于忧愁而双眉紧锁。形容心事重重。

examples.zh: 这几天他愁眉不展，好像有什么心事。
examples.en: He's been frowning with worry these past few days, as if something's on his mind.

examples.zh: 孩子成绩下滑，妈妈整天愁眉不展。
examples.en: With her child's grades slipping, Mum has looked worried all day.

natural: a long-term plan of fundamental importance

meaning.en: A plan of lasting, fundamental importance.
meaning.zh: 关系到长远利益的重要计划或措施。

equivalents: a cause for generations to come

examples.zh: 教育是国家的百年大计。
examples.en: Education is a long-term undertaking of fundamental importance to the nation.

examples.zh: 城市规划是百年大计，不能急功近利。
examples.en: Urban planning is for generations to come; there's no room for quick fixes.

meaning.en: Trivial details.
meaning.zh: 比喻事情或问题的细小而无关紧要的部分。

examples.zh: 先把大方向定下来，细枝末节以后再说。
examples.en: Let's settle the general direction first and worry about minor details later.

examples.zh: 他总是纠结于细枝末节。
examples.en: He always gets hung up on trivial details.

meaning.en: To know absolutely nothing about something.
meaning.zh: 比喻一点也不懂。

examples.zh: 我对电脑一窍不通。
examples.en: I haven't a clue about computers.

examples.zh: 他对音乐一窍不通，却总爱评论。
examples.en: He knows nothing about music but loves to comment on it.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“对……一窍不通”。

antonyms: 油漆匠的家当——有两把刷子

meaning.en: To run away in defeat.
meaning.zh: 离开大路，向荒野逃跑。形容战败或受挫后狼狈逃走。

examples.zh: 敌军被打得落荒而逃。
examples.en: The enemy were routed and fled in disarray.

examples.zh: 面对记者的追问，他落荒而逃。
examples.en: Faced with reporters' questions, he beat a hasty retreat.

natural: make a clean breast of it

meaning.en: To reveal everything without holding back.
meaning.zh: 连盘子一起端出来。比喻全部说出来，毫无保留。

equivalents: make a clean breast of it
lay all one's cards on the table

examples.zh: 在证据面前，他把事情经过和盘托出。
examples.en: Faced with the evidence, he came clean about everything.

examples.zh: 她把自己的计划向父母和盘托出。
examples.en: She laid out her whole plan to her parents.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用“把……和盘托出”。

meaning.en: A small flaw in something otherwise good.
meaning.zh: 虽然很好，但还有缺陷。

examples.zh: 这家酒店很好，美中不足的是离地铁有点远。
examples.en: The hotel is great; the only drawback is that it's a bit far from the metro.

examples.zh: 比赛精彩，美中不足的是下了雨。
examples.en: It was a great match — the only fly in the ointment was the rain.

synonyms: 西施掉了门牙——美中不足

natural: not content to stay out of the limelight

meaning.en: Unwilling to stay in the background; eager to join in or be noticed.
meaning.zh: 不甘心冷清孤独，想参与或出头露面。

equivalents: not content to sit on the sidelines
eager to get in on the act

examples.zh: 看到别人都在创业，他也不甘寂寞。
examples.en: Seeing everyone else starting businesses, he wasn't content to sit on the sidelines.

examples.zh: 这位过气明星不甘寂寞，又频频上热搜。
examples.en: The fading star, craving attention, keeps trending online again.

usage.en: Predicate; can be neutral or mildly mocking.
